description: 100-lap aging-test variant of motegi_oval_2025_full_v2; identical course geometry and artwork.

source.note: Same branch construction as the complete-course illustration; endpoints use supplied coordinates. Small corrections blend branches into the oval.

lap_update.note: Supplied lap-update point projected onto the reference driving path for route continuity. This is not a defined timing gate.

distance_conventions.segments: s_m begins at the first point of each segment; oval zero is lap_update_on_route.
distance_conventions.routes: s_m begins at each route start; regular_lap repeats its endpoint explicitly. All routes have closed=false.
distance_conventions.v1_compatibility: Schema 2 uses segments and routes instead of top-level points. Oval s_m zero changed; do not reuse v1 s_m values.
